25353:     function auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player) {
25354:       const key = state.auction?.rolePhase?.key || 'ALL';
25355:       const mode = state.auction?.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic';
25356: 
25357:       if (!player || key === 'ALL') return true;
25358: 
25359:       if (mode === 'classic') {
25360:         return key === 'OUTFIELD'
25361:           ? player.classic_role !== 'P'
25362:           : player.classic_role === key;
25363:       }
25364: 
25365:       const goalkeeper = playerRoles(player, mode)
25366:         .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
25367: 
25368:       if (key === 'POR') return goalkeeper;
25369:       if (key === 'OUTFIELD') return !goalkeeper;
25370:       return true;
25371:     }

19240:     function auctionSuggestedCallScore(player) {
19241:       const d = state.auction || {};
19242:       const info = auctionMyTeamDashboardData();
19243: 
19244:       if (!player || !info) {
19245:         return null;
19246:       }
19247: 
19248:       if (!auctionPlayerMatchesCurrentRolePhase(player)) {
19249:         return null;
19250:       }
19251: 
19252:       const capacity = auctionQueueCapacityForPlayer(player);
19253:       if (!capacity.allowed) {
19254:         return null;
19255:       }
19256: 
19257:       if (
19258:         auctionQueueRows()
19259:           .some(item => item.player_id === player.id)
19260:       ) {
19261:         return null;
19262:       }
19263: 
19264:       const mode = d.settings?.fantasy_mode || 'classic';
19265:       const assignments = info.assignments || [];
19266:       const queue = auctionQueueRows();
19267:       let needScore = 0;
19268:       let needLabel = '';
19269: 
19270:       if (mode === 'classic') {
19271:         const role = player.classic_role || '—';
19272:         const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[role]?.min || 0);
19273:         const acquired = assignments.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
19274:         const queued = queue.filter(item => item.player?.classic_role === role).length;
19275:         const missing = Math.max(0, min - acquired);
19276:         const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);
19277: 
19278:         needScore =
19279:           uncovered > 0
19280:             ? 70 + Math.min(20, uncovered * 8)
19281:             : missing > 0
19282:               ? 42
19283:               : 8;
19284: 
19285:         needLabel =
19286:           uncovered > 0
19287:             ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${role} al minimo`
19288:             : missing > 0
19289:               ? `${role} già coperto in Coda, ma non ancora acquistato`
19290:               : `Slot ${role} ancora disponibile`;
19291:       } else {
19292:         const goalkeeper = playerRoles(player, mode)
19293:           .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
19294:         const bucket = goalkeeper ? 'Por' : 'MOV';
19295:         const label = goalkeeper ? 'portieri' : 'movimento';
19296:         const min = Number(info.roleLimits?.[bucket]?.min || 0);
19297:         const isGoalkeeper = candidate => playerRoles(candidate || {}, mode)
19298:           .some(role => ['P', 'Por'].includes(role));
19299:         const acquired = assignments.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
19300:         const queued = queue.filter(item => goalkeeper === isGoalkeeper(item.player)).length;
19301:         const uncovered = Math.max(0, min - acquired - queued);
19302: 
19303:         needScore = uncovered > 0 ? 76 + Math.min(18, uncovered * 7) : 10;
19304:         needLabel = uncovered > 0
19305:           ? `Mancano ${uncovered} ${label} al minimo`
19306:           : `${label[0].toUpperCase()+label.slice(1)} compatibile con la rosa`;
19307:       }
19308: 
19309:       const pfc = Number(player.pfc || 0);
19310:       const pma = Number(player.pma || 0);
19311:       const expectedFm = Number(player.expected_fantasy_avg || 0);
19312:       const tit = Number(player.expected_titolarity || 0);
19313:       const quotation = Number(player.quotation || 0);
19314:       const slot = Number(player.slot || 0);
19315:       const maxBid = Number(info.maxBid ?? info.remaining ?? 0);
19316: 
19317:       let valueScore =
19318:         Math.min(24, Math.max(0, pfc) * .18)
19319:         + Math.min(18, Math.max(0, pma) * .12)
19320:         + Math.min(12, Math.max(0, expectedFm) * 1.1)
19321:         + Math.min(10, Math.max(0, tit) * .10);
19322: 
19323:       if (slot > 0) {
19324:         valueScore += Math.max(0, 14 - slot * 2.5);
19325:       }

20719:     const AUCTION_FREE_NUMERIC = {
20720:       presence: { label: '%Tit', step: 1 },
20721:       pfc: { label: 'PFC', step: 1 },
20722:       pma: { label: 'PMA', step: 1 },
20723:       delta: { label: 'Delta', step: 1 },
20724:       fm: { label: 'FM', step: .01 },
20725:       index: { label: 'Indice', step: 1 }
20726:     };
20727: 
20728:     function auctionFreeFinite(value) {
20729:       const n = Number(value);
20730:       return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
20731:     }
20732: 
20733:     function auctionFreePresence(player) {
20734:       const value = typeof strategicPresencePercent === 'function'
20735:         ? strategicPresencePercent(player)
20736:         : player?.expected_titolarity;
20737:       return auctionFreeFinite(value) ?? 0;
20738:     }
20739: 
20740:     function auctionFreeFantasyAverage(player) {
20741:       const value = typeof strategicExpectedFantasyAverage === 'function'
20742:         ? strategicExpectedFantasyAverage(player)
20743:         : player?.expected_fantasy_avg;
20744:       return auctionFreeFinite(value) ?? 0;
20745:     }
20746: 
20747:     function auctionFreeDelta(player) {
20748:       const imported = auctionFreeFinite(player?.pfc_pma_delta);
20749:       if (imported !== null) return imported;
20750:       const pfc = auctionFreeFinite(player?.pfc);
20751:       const pma = auctionFreeFinite(player?.pma);
20752:       return pfc !== null && pma !== null ? pfc - pma : null;
20753:     }
20754: 
20755:     function auctionFreeIndex(player) {
20756:       const value = typeof strategicValueIndex === 'function'
20757:         ? strategicValueIndex(player)
20758:         : 0;
20759:       return auctionFreeFinite(value) ?? 0;
20760:     }
20761: 
20762:     function auctionFreeNumericValue(player, key) {
20763:       if (key === 'presence') return auctionFreePresence(player);
20764:       if (key === 'pfc') return auctionFreeFinite(player?.pfc);
20765:       if (key === 'pma') return auctionFreeFinite(player?.pma);
20766:       if (key === 'delta') return auctionFreeDelta(player);
20767:       if (key === 'fm') return auctionFreeFantasyAverage(player);
20768:       if (key === 'index') return auctionFreeIndex(player);
20769:       return null;
20770:     }
20771: 
20772:     function auctionFreePreference(player) {
20773:       const source = String(player?.source_player_id || player?.id || '');
20774:       return state.v7Preferences?.get?.(source) || null;
20775:     }
20776: 
20777:     function auctionFreeFavorite(player) {
20778:       const pref = auctionFreePreference(player);
20779:       return Boolean(pref?.is_favorite || pref?.strategy === 'top');
20780:     }
20781:

20786:       if (key === 'new') return player?.new_arrival === true;
20787:       if (key === 'injury') {
20788:         return player?.uncertain_return === true

18817:         };
